extracted_information: Hootsuite offers three main plans: Standard, Advanced, and Enterprise. Pricing is tiered and based on annual billing, with specific prices for Standard and Advanced plans noted as placeholders in the content (e.g., 'start at for a Standard plan'). The Enterprise plan is custom-priced. All paid plans include a 30-day free trial, after which regular billing begins unless canceled. Accepted payment methods include Visa, Mastercard, Discover, JCB, and PayPal; annual Enterprise plans can be invoiced, payable by credit card, check, wire, or ACH. Hootsuite offers a discounted rate for nonprofits on some plans.
